method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); the law in a rules module, the questions in three seat modules importing it; three regulative rules (ss 16(3), 34, 43/44) each run by EVALTRACE inside an exported question that takes only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.

seats: the provider: the person who provides, or wants to provide, labour hire services (a sole trader, partners, or the officer answering for a company), as applicant and licence holder (lhl-seat.l4)
the host: the business that uses labour hire, and the client of s 16 (lhl-seat-host.l4)
the worker: the individual supplied, recruited or placed by a provider (s 9) (lhl-seat-worker.l4)
